kultivator.sekte.cmd.help.title: Living Sect — test commands
kultivator.sekte.cmd.help.intro: Click to fill the chat box. Every module adds its own commands.
kultivator.sekte.cmd.reload.fail: %s could not be read; the old values stay.
kultivator.sekte.cmd.player.help: Sect (the Living Sect, also /kultivasi sekte): murid, hubungan, turnamen, tangga, paviliun, tetua, misi, lambang, diplomasi, kebun. Type one for its sub-commands.
kultivator.cheat.group.perguruan.desc: personality, ties, tournament, stair, pavilion, elders, missions, emblem, diplomacy, garden
kultivator.sekte.sifat.rajin.desc: Trains unasked: faster meditation, more work done.
kultivator.sekte.sifat.malas.desc: Finds a corner to nap: slower meditation, but rarely complains.
kultivator.sekte.sifat.sombong.desc: Proud of its gift: bold in the arena, stung by every humiliation.
kultivator.sekte.sifat.rendah_hati.desc: Easy to teach and quick to befriend.
kultivator.sekte.sifat.setia.desc: Hard to shake; stays far longer before leaving.
kultivator.sekte.sifat.licik.desc: Brings more home from missions, but betrays more easily.
kultivator.sekte.sifat.berani.desc: Fights longer and does not flinch at danger.
kultivator.sekte.sifat.penakut.desc: Retreats early, but is rarely badly hurt.
kultivator.sekte.sifat.ambisius.desc: Chases breakthroughs; bitter when passed over.
kultivator.sekte.sifat.tenang.desc: Its heart seldom stirs; its mood moves at half speed.
kultivator.sekte.sifat.penyayang.desc: Looks after its fellows; its grudges fade fast.
kultivator.sekte.sifat.pendendam.desc: Never forgets a wound, from anyone.
